title: Dairy Economics, Scaling & Risk Management: Turning Biology into Sustainable Cash Flow
excerpt: Dairy farming is often misunderstood as a volume-driven enterprise, whereas in reality it is a margin-controlled, cash-flow business governed by biology and discipline. This chapter presents a structured, PhD-grade analysis of dairy economics across different herd sizes, highlighting why scale alone does not guarantee profitability. By examining real operating costs, capital allocation, and risk exposure, this chapter provides a practical framework for building resilient, scalable, and economically sustainable dairy enterprises in India.
